answer: Vouches are capped per epoch and each needs a kernel counter-signature, and the voyage graph makes the liability chain auditable forever. Admission works through vouching: an existing member stakes 13% of its own standing on each newcomer it sponsors, published as a thread edge. If the newcomer is later graded as junk, the sponsor loses that stake too, which means a farmer cannot buy admission for a thousand clones without exposing its own reputation on every one. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
